node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (1,1,2) source-line odd-part incidence gate
node.closure: internal-orbit unramified common-root gate and explicit odd-part incidence map for unramified forced-square packets
node.statement: In every saturated source-line diagonal (1,1,2) packet, the unique internal common-K orbit is unramified and the two pure stars over either fiber share exactly one J_0 endpoint a, forcing U(a,z)=V(a,z)=0. If the forced square orbit w is also unramified, deck distinction and the square cut uniquely pin the projective odd part V. The internal label must then equal one explicit rational value z=-N_epsilon(a)/D_epsilon(a), with nonzero denominator, for one sign and one J_0 orbit. This is an exact deletion gate, not a packet or row deletion.
